A large '''flying carnivore''' was [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mycroft]] in the [[Fakir sector/Legends|Fakir sector]]. It possessed a [[Snake/Legends|snake]]-like body and had thirty [[Centimeter/Legends|centimeter]]-long [[Tooth/Legends|fangs]] that were capable of delivering a [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] bite. The carnivore inhabited the low, [[Forest/Legends|forest]]-covered [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] on the planet.<ref name="Assault" />

{{RPG|"[[Assault on Repair Station M13 (adventure)|Assault on Repair Station M13]]"}}
During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Reekeene's Roughnecks]]' [[Green squad]] were deployed on a [[Assault on Repair Station M13|mission]] to Mycroft. The carnivores had [[Diet/Legends|starved]] during the harsh [[Winter/Legends|winter]], and were ravenously hungry. The presence of the carnivores in the area was a potential hazard to the Rebel agents' mission.<ref name="Assault" />
